description: This file implements data access methods for Category entities, including retrieval by name, URL, code, IDs, lineage, depth, parent, store, and product counts. It extends a generic DAO class and uses QueryDSL and JPA for database interactions within a Spring repository context.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CategoryDao providing various query methods for Category entities using QueryDSL and JPA.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a name pattern for a given store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a specific SEO URL for a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a single category matching an SEO URL for a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code for a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a list of codes for a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by a list of IDs for a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories with a lineage starting with a specific string for a store or store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth for a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a specific parent category for a store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories for a store and parent category, handling null cases.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products in given categories for a store, with filtering for availability and date.

methods.name: listByStore (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories for a store filtered by language.
